title: Configuration
themeDescription: Configure the login interface, administration theme, layout, tab bar, and other interface preferences.

login.title: Login Page
login.description: Control the login page color theme and form position.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Control the administration color theme and display mode.

tabbar.title: Tab Bar
tabbar.description: Control administration tab visibility, interaction, and persistence.

loginTheme.label: Login page theme
loginTheme.description: Set the primary color shown to every visitor on the login page.

loginLayout.label: Login page layout
loginLayout.description: Place the login form on the left, center, or right.

adminTheme.label: Administration theme
adminTheme.description: Set the primary color for buttons, menus, and controls.

adminThemeMode.label: Administration mode
adminThemeMode.description: Use light, dark, or operating-system appearance.

adminLayout.label: Administration layout
adminLayout.description: Choose the navigation and content layout for the administration panel.

tabbarPersist.label: Persist tabs
tabbarPersist.description: Restore opened tabs after refreshing or returning to the administration panel.

tabbarVisitHistory.label: Visit history
tabbarVisitHistory.description: Return to the previously visited tab when closing the current tab.

tabbarMaxCount.label: Maximum tabs
tabbarMaxCount.description: Set to 0 for no limit, up to a maximum of 30.

tabbarDraggable.label: Enable drag sorting
tabbarDraggable.description: Allow tabs to be reordered by dragging.

tabbarWheelable.label: Enable vertical wheel
tabbarWheelable.description: Allow the mouse wheel to scroll horizontally through tabs.

tabbarMiddleClickToClose.label: Middle-click to close
tabbarMiddleClickToClose.description: Allow tabs to be closed with the middle mouse button.

tabbarShowIcon.label: Show tab icons
tabbarShowIcon.description: Display the corresponding menu icon before each tab title.

tabbarShowMore.label: Show more button
tabbarShowMore.description: Display the batch tab actions entry.

tabbarStyleType.label: Tab style
tabbarStyleType.description: Choose the visual style used by administration tabs.
